summary: Diff adds a new Landing page shown to unauthenticated users (with URL-hash mode switching), blush-themed styling tokens, a static screenshot carousel with swipe + next/prev controls, a founder story content module, and a dialog component intended for footer links. Some requirements (full section set, stable anchor IDs, and exact footer link labeling/behavior) cannot be fully verified from the truncated diff summary; branding asset files themselves are also not evidenced as added.

missing_requirements.requirement: Landing page contains all required sections (Hero, Benefit Trio, Product Screenshot Carousel, Founder Story, Privacy Reassurance, Optional Feature Deep-dives, Final CTA, Footer) and each section has stable anchor IDs for footer navigation.
missing_requirements.reason: Only some sections/IDs are visible in the truncated Landing.tsx snippet (e.g., Benefit Trio has id="features"); the rest of the required sections and their anchor IDs are not evidenced in the provided diff summary.

missing_requirements.requirement: Footer displays five labeled links (About, Contact, Terms, Privacy, and exactly “Interested in supporting our growth?”) and each link navigates to a section or opens an on-page modal/sheet (no dead links).
missing_requirements.reason: A dialog component for footer link content exists, but the actual footer link UI (including exact link label text and click behavior) is not shown in the diff summary; additionally, the investor dialog title uses different capitalization than the required exact footer link label (title is not the label, but the label cannot be verified).

missing_requirements.requirement: New generated branding assets exist in frontend/public/assets/generated (logo icon, wordmark, hero illustration, and 3 screenshots) and are referenced by the landing page.
missing_requirements.reason: Landing page and carousel reference the required asset paths under /assets/generated, but the diff summary does not show the actual image files being added under frontend/public/assets/generated (likely binary/non-LLM-readable and omitted).
